name: Monopoly Spider-Man
theme: New York, from the rooftops to the villains' lairs
tagline: Collector edition: capture the villains, spin your towers.
summary: Classic Monopoly on the Spider-Man board: capture super-villains and New York landmarks, place tracers and web towers, mortgage, and outlast everyone.

cards.web-01: Emergency patrol: advance to GO. Collect $200.
cards.web-02: Final showdown: go straight to the Green Goblin.
cards.web-03: Back to class: go to Midtown High School. If you pass GO, collect $200.
cards.web-04: Photo delivery: advance to the Daily Bugle Building. If you pass GO, collect $200.
cards.web-05: Emergency tactical vehicle: advance to the nearest vehicle. If it is owned, pay the owner twice the rental.
cards.web-06: Emergency tactical vehicle: advance to the nearest vehicle. If it is owned, pay the owner twice the rental.
cards.web-07: Grid failure: go to the nearest service. Throw the dice and pay the owner ten times the amount thrown.
cards.web-08: Spider-Mobile launch: go directly to the Spider-Mobile.
cards.web-09: Parker Industries dividend: collect $50 from the bank.
cards.web-10: Escape from The Vault. This card may be kept until used or sold.
cards.web-12: Caught by the NYPD: go directly to The Vault. Do not pass GO, do not collect $200.
cards.web-13: Web-shooter and hideout maintenance: pay $25 per tracer and $100 per web tower you own.
cards.web-14: Speeding between skyscrapers: pay a $15 fine.
cards.web-15: Pizza at Joe's for the whole block: pay each player $50.
cards.web-16: Bravery award from the Mayor of New York: collect $150 from the bank.
cards.bugle-01: Spider-Man spotted in the city: advance to GO. Collect $200.
cards.bugle-02: An exclusive sold to J. Jonah Jameson — bank error in your favour: collect $200.
cards.bugle-03: Property damage caused by the Rhino: pay $50 to the Manhattan hospital.
cards.bugle-05: Cleared by the security cameras: get out of The Vault free. This card may be kept until used or sold.
cards.bugle-06: Arrest warrant issued by Jameson: go directly to The Vault. Do not pass GO, do not collect $200.
cards.bugle-07: Surprise birthday at Aunt May's: collect $10 from every other player.
cards.bugle-10: Runner-up at the robotics contest: collect $10.
cards.bugle-11: Family visit: go directly to Aunt May's House.
cards.bugle-13: Research funding from Horizon Labs: collect $100.
cards.bugle-14: Rebuilding after an urban fight: pay $40 per tracer and $115 per web tower you own.
